evidence.reason: Company reports 20,605 total workforce, approximately €6.5bn revenue and €1.42bn adjusted profit for 2025.
Current official executive roster identifies Ana Doval as Chief People & Culture Officer.
CPO's current public professional profile confirms title and employer; direct reach, warm introduction and buying intent are unconfirmed.
Company's own interview states it signed for the full ServiceNow suite including ITSM/ITOM and NowAssist.
Moveworks confirms deployed employee agent Hubert integrated with ServiceNow and expanding to Workday; adjacent automation adoption, not a new buying timeline.
Completed HCM transformation and ongoing cross-market change confirmed, but launch calendar date unavailable.

why_now: Workday-based cross-market HR operations now sit alongside expanded ServiceNow and Moveworks automation. New interfaces and AI-enabled employee workflows create a plausible regression and integration testing discussion, supported by profitable 2025 operations; a specific active procurement trigger remains unconfirmed.
persona: People technology owner with CPO and digital workplace sponsors
gaps: Workday go-live calendar date unavailable despite customer-story, issuer and professional-post searches.
Exact current titles of Patricia de la Fuente and Frederick Ros need reconfirmation.
Direct buyer emails/phones, email verification, team mutuals and demonstrated willingness to act unconfirmed.
No committed Mando allocation or purchasing deadline.
research_notes: Do not confuse Amadeus IT Group with the NEC Group catering business named Amadeus; its 2016 Reflexis announcement is unrelated. Sylvain Roy is current CTO; Christophe Bousquet left in 2022. Company report replaces 2021 financial figures in the Workday story. No scores changed.
